title: Linear interface atlas
scope: 64 additional screenshots; the five previously collected source images are excluded. Offline originals retain the bytes of the linked CDN assets.

images.title: Team directory
images.description: The navigation rail stays open beside a table of teams. Membership and short team identifiers align in separate columns.

images.title: Team home and pinned resources
images.description: The light-mode team overview groups pinned documents under headings, with members, quick links and sub-teams in a separate right column.

images.title: My issues by status
images.description: Assigned, Created, Subscribed and Activity tabs sit over the issue list. Shaded group headers divide review, in-progress and backlog rows.

images.title: Custom view editor
images.description: A view title, description, save destination and editable filters occupy a band above grouped results. A separate rail shows the view owner and visibility.

images.title: Custom view overview rail
images.description: The right rail stacks a saved view’s description, visibility and owner above assignee counts, with tabs for labels and projects.

images.title: List and board display controls
images.description: A display popover combines a layout selector, grouping, ordering and visibility toggles with individual chips for the properties shown on rows.

images.title: Filtered active issues
images.description: Assignee and label filters appear as chips above the issue groups. Rows retain status symbols and compact metadata.

images.title: Quarterly project board
images.description: Quarter columns intersect with planned, in-progress and complete swimlanes. Individual project cards carry a description, dates and members.

images.title: New issue composer
images.description: The title and description fill the upper half. Small property buttons sit below the text, with the primary create action in the footer.

images.title: Bulk selection in an issue list
images.description: Three checked issues share a blue selection background within the In Review group. Status headers and unselected rows retain their usual contrast.

images.title: Triage routing rules
images.description: Each rule pairs a plain-language name with When and Then rows. Small property chips express the condition and resulting action.

images.title: Issue discussion and reactions
images.description: An issue description leads into a chronological activity feed. Comments, an emoji reaction and an inline composer sit within the same content column.

images.title: Issue activity summary
images.description: A light-mode issue detail places description and discussion summary in the main column and status, priority, assignee, cycle and project in the right rail.

images.title: Structured bug report composer
images.description: A bug report template divides the composer into title, reproduction steps and component fields. Secondary property controls and the create action remain in the footer.

images.title: Parent issue and sub-issue row
images.description: A child issue sits between the parent description and activity feed. The child’s own metadata stays inline while the parent has a separate properties rail.

images.title: Triage suggestions under an issue title
images.description: A bordered panel collects suggested assignee and labels, a possible duplicate and related issues directly beneath the title.

images.title: Assignee suggestion detail
images.description: An anchored panel explains an assignee suggestion, offers an alternate assignee and puts the acceptance action below the reasoning.

images.title: Search and recent issues
images.description: The search field sits above a four-row list of recently opened issues, next to the workspace sidebar.

images.title: Assignee suggestions as you type
images.description: Typing @ma after “android bug” opens a light menu of matching people with avatars.

images.title: A favorite in the sidebar
images.description: Mobile Synced Drafts is selected under Favorites. The star beside the project title reflects the same state.

images.title: Grouped filter rules
images.description: Nested filter rows combine project, priority, SLA status and team conditions. The inset left edge shows which rules belong together.

images.title: Natural-language filter suggestions
images.description: The AI filter popover sits over an issue list and offers phrases such as “assigned to me” and “due in the next 2 weeks.”

images.title: Priority and Other inbox tabs
images.description: The priority count sits next to its tab. Each notification combines an avatar, an event summary and a small status icon.

images.title: Inbox display settings
images.description: The settings popover overlays a split inbox and issue view, grouping priority controls, unread grouping and ordering.

images.title: Remind me about an issue
images.description: The reminder picker accepts a typed time and lists four date shortcuts with their exact dates aligned on the right.

images.title: A project update in Pulse
images.description: A Voice Customization update shows its health and date above a short write-up, with reaction counts below.

images.title: Initiatives by status
images.description: Nested initiative rows share a narrow title column. Status groups and aligned health, target and owner columns keep the hierarchy legible.

images.title: Initiative progress across projects
images.description: A highlighted project curve and floating label stand out from a stack of muted progress curves.

images.title: Multi-project timeline
images.description: Project bars carry titles, people and milestone symbols across a vertical calendar grid. A single date line crosses every row.

images.title: Milestone on a timeline
images.description: Hovering the Private Beta milestone opens a small card directly over stacked project tracks.

images.title: Dependencies between timeline rows
images.description: A compact project list shares a row baseline with timeline bars. Curved connectors link the blocking project to two dependent projects.

images.title: Nested initiatives in light mode
images.description: Indentation and disclosure controls organize parent initiatives and sub-initiatives. Compact columns carry owner, health and target information.

images.title: Cycle detail alongside issues
images.description: The Cycle 13 pane sits beside a sliver of the issue list. Three progress figures sit above a chart of scope and completed work.

images.title: Expanded cycle in the cycle list
images.description: An expanded cycle row embeds its progress chart between neighboring cycles. A small legend and figures sit to the right.

images.title: Project overview and resources
images.description: The Mexico launch overview stacks a short summary, compact properties, resource chips and a written update in one column.

images.title: Initiative update popover
images.description: An update card floats over the initiative table. Health appears above the body, with reactions and reply details below.

images.title: Release detail and issue list
images.description: A versioned iOS release keeps the issue table on the left and shows release metadata and summary breakdowns in a right inspector.

images.title: Release badges on an issue
images.description: Compact pills put release versions beside issue rows. The expanded stack shows iOS, nightly and internal release entries.

images.title: Versioned release changelog
images.description: The pipeline’s Changelog tab stacks version headings, dates and bulleted release notes in a single reading column.

images.title: Project document reading view
images.description: The Agenda and preparation document uses a narrow text column, section headings and space between blocks beneath a compact toolbar.

images.title: Sharing a document
images.description: The sharing popover layers people, access level, link controls and the destination menu over a dark document.

images.title: Guided review by change
images.description: Short explanations down the left describe the backend policy, endpoint and client flow. File summaries align with each explanation on the right.

images.title: Filter reviews by GitHub label
images.description: A filter menu opens a second column of color-coded labels and matching pull-request counts over the review queue.

images.title: Diff display options
images.description: A narrow popover overlays the code. Split and Unified controls sit above highlighting, wrapping, file ordering and code theme preferences.

images.title: Pull-request risk breakdown
images.description: A light-mode popover explains three risk areas beside the review properties, which include status, linked issue, reviewers and branch.

images.title: Filter a diff by commit
images.description: The commit chip opens a list of all commits, recent agent changes and a specific commit. The file tree stays visible behind the menu.

images.title: Merged pull request in issue activity
images.description: A merged pull-request attachment sits above a chronological record of GitHub moving the issue from Backlog through Review to Done.

images.title: Map pull-request events to statuses
images.description: Five event rows map draft creation, opening a pull request, review activity, readiness and merge to status dropdowns with distinct glyphs.

images.title: Workspace dashboard directory
images.description: The Dashboards tab lists saved dashboards with icons and owners. Workspace navigation and the New dashboard action remain visible.

images.title: Issue counts by assignee
images.description: Stacked columns by assignee share a horizontal axis with avatar labels. A supporting table lists status counts and a slim settings column defines the chart.

images.title: Save a view’s insight to a dashboard
images.description: The Active Bugs list remains on the left while an Insights sidebar shows issue counts by status. Its action menu includes Add to dashboard.

images.title: Bug and cycle performance
images.description: One row combines issue volume over time, a priority table and a 58-minute median triage metric. The next row begins with resolution time and bug age.

images.title: Data-team request dashboard
images.description: Four status totals line up above individual burn-up charts. Two tables below identify issues to update or review for closure.

images.title: Weekly engineering dashboard
images.description: Assignee tables lead into charts for quality fixes, Sentry issues, triage volume and bug creation over time.

images.title: High-priority backlog by team
images.description: A stacked area chart tracks high-priority work by team. A second, full-width plot below compares SLA outcomes.

images.title: Cycle time by assignee
images.description: A wide scatterplot compares cycle times across assignees. Below it, two smaller bar charts show high-priority issues by team and tickets in triage.

images.title: Personalizing the navigation sidebar
images.description: Four sidebar configurations sit beside the customization menu, where personal and workspace sections have individual visibility controls.

images.title: Issue actions in the command palette
images.description: An issue command palette groups assignment, status, priority, estimate and label actions, with shortcut keys aligned at the right.

images.title: Searchable keyboard shortcuts
images.description: Searching for “Open” in the shortcuts panel narrows the General and Navigation sections and leaves the key combinations visible.

images.title: Nested issue actions
images.description: A context menu opens on an issue row. Its Labels submenu extends sideways with Bug, Feature and Improvement choices.

images.title: Desktop tabs before and after the refresh
images.description: The two tab strips show how pinned icon tabs and shorter titles change the space left for the active item. The March 2026 revision is below.

images.title: The rail and header around the inbox
images.description: Colored overlays identify the left navigation, location bar and view controls around a dark inbox and its selected issue.

images.title: One sidebar across three environments
images.description: The browser, Windows and macOS versions of the same dark sidebar show the different placements of window controls, search and the project tab.

images.title: Two contrast settings in dark mode
images.description: The same sidebar selection and list header appear at contrast settings of 30 and 100. The high-contrast version appears below.
